name: Blinding Aura
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Uncheck a Condition. If you did, choose a creature within short range. That creature is surrounded by an aura of blinding light. Attacks against the creature are ill-favored.

Additionally, whenever an attack targets the creature, roll Spirit vs Spirit against the attacker. If the Condition you unchecked was Troubled, your roll is favored. On a win, the attacker must choose a different target.

Describe the light.
successes:
✨: Win or lose, the attacker must move 10 ft away from the creature if they are able before their attack may proceed.

🌞: The attack fails entirely with no effect. Costs paid for the attack are still consumed.
